_doc: Gate G-T1b (PLAN_tactics_settings.md section 2): the two G-T1 knobs patched in the attribulator EBX at load by Turbo's Oodle hook (turbogui/src/core/attrib_ebx.h). Copy to turbo_output\attrib_preset.json to switch the patch on for the next launch (the file's presence IS the switch; turbo_output\attrib_ebx_off.txt overrides it). mode observe = recognise and log only. offset / type_sig / expect from docs/re/attrib_inventory_6AC07E31.json (group gp_positioningformation_attackinglinelengthwidth, AttribSchema_gp_positioningformation_linelengthwidth); the offsets equal knobs_6AC07E31.json. Values below the sliders' bounds on purpose (extreme gate).
